Hello,

Adding some background to this ticket on behalf of the contractor liaison. Access will be used from my managed laptop and only during office hours. The access is for preparing the audit binder that external reviewers will read. Monday is a public holiday for our office, so expect slower replies that day.

This comment is informational; it does not change the scope of the work and nothing further is needed from the assignee. Thank you for your patience.

Rafi
